Results.ReviewText: I love this grill!  It does everything I want and it looks good, too (Ocean Blue).  However, I took off one star for two quality control issues: 1) the main kettle handle on the side was bent which made it difficult to install the handle pieces.  2) The interior vanes don't fully cover the vent holes when in the closed position; there's still a tiny gap that allows air into the kettle when shutting everything down.  All in all, still a great grill.  Thanks.
Results.Title: Great grill, less than stellar quality control.

Results.ReviewText:
Overall a good grill. I switched from propane this summer to this relatively inexpensive model. Purchased many first and third party accessories. Very happy with the overall quality. The temp fluctuates a lot more than I would have expected which knocks this down a start rating... but I wasn't really expecting it to be locked in anyway. Expected to have to babysit it a little, but that is kind of part of the attraction. I have fallen in love with grilling again thanks to this unit and expect that through trial and error, I will become better each season. I have not touched my propane grill since I bought this thing, even for something as simple as hot dogs. 

Wish I had actually bought the larger model with charcoal storage instead of having to store in my shed, well away from my grill area. Might trade up in a few years.
Results.Title: Limited complaints, will get even better with time

Results.ReviewText:
I bought this grill about a year ago and have not been happy with it from day one.  I have owned Weber Kettle grills approximately 40 years.  (My entire adult life). I bought this one not because I needed it, my old standard grill that I have had for over 15 years still works fine but I just wanted to spoil myself with the additional accessories and the thermometer.  I have never had a grill with a thermometer before.  Always have had just the standard, basic 22”kettle.  Anyway, from the first time I used it I noticed the lid fits loose and just sits on the rim of the base.  There is no type of air tight seal at all.  Once the coals are hot the only way to turn down the heat is completely close both the top and bottom vents and even then it won’t go below approximately 375 degrees.  With both vents closed the coals should go out.  The lid is not damaged or “out of round” it just doesn’t fit right, it is almost like it’s about 1/2 inch too big, leaving a gap for air to come in.
  I used it again this past Memorial Day weekend to celebrate with family and friends and cooked a full rack of babyback ribs.  I have learned over the past year the only way I can manage to get the temperature low enough to cook “low and slow” is I have to completely close both vents and balance a cinder block on top of the lid to get it to fit tighter.
  So, after this past weekend I have had enough and decided to say something.  If you decide to buy one you better pick up a cinder block while you’re at it.
Results.Title: Lid doesn’t fit!

ClientResponses.Response: Hello, thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We are sorry to learn about the disappointment of the legs. We have shared your concerns with our design team. Please, if you experience any issues or concerns, please do not hesitate to reach out to our support team. Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber grills

Results.ReviewText: During assembly, 2 of the 3 legs were difficult to install as they did not fit correctly into the matching port in the lower grill bowl. The legs and the spring-like insert that is supposed to lock the legs in place are made of cheap, flimsy metal.  I was very disappointed with the quality.  Did not expect this from a Weber product.

Results.ReviewText: The grill was very easy to build and obviously well-designed. Well-written instructions. I saw that it's a fantastic grill before I even started using it! The excellent User Guide said to do a trial run without food, and temperature got up to 515 degrees Fahrenheit, which is hotter than necessary for cooking. I'm a new griller and I definitely recommend this grill. No regrets!
Results.Title: Excellent Grill! Really happy.

Results.ReviewText:
It's mostly great, and I'm proud of it.  However, it's very top heavy, and I'm afraid of it falling over every time I try to move it, which makes me drag the leg a lot.  The wheel and handle set up doesn't help with stairs.  I have a deck I store the grill on, and I have to lift the whole grill every time I want to use it, and put it away, which isn't easy on my back, and I've recently developed hip problems.  For example, I have a toter for recycling, and the handle is on the same side as the wheels.  It's much easier to learn it towards me, and roll it around, and with stairs I can pull it, and roll it over the steps, or ease it down without having to carry the full weight.  The toter is easier on 2 flights of stairs than the grill is for a few steps.

It just seems like a few design oversights, and perhaps slight adjustments could make handling, and moving the grill much easier and safer.

Also, perhaps it's user error, but even with all the vents fully open, it seems like the charcoal doesn't burn hot enough with the lid closed.  I keep clearing out as much ashe as I can, but when I put the lid on, after a little bit, it's almost out, like it's suffocating.  Maybe I need to clean the grill or something, cause the first time this wasn't an issue at all, I was amazed by how hot it got.  Like I said, maybe that's on me, and not the grills fault, cause I only use the cleaning system, and haven't done a thorough cleaning yet.
Results.Title: Almost perfect.

Results.ReviewText: Super achat ! J’apprivoise la Cuisson au charbon.  A chaque semaine je suis meilleur! Le goût est excellent, je ne regrette pas mon bbq. Bonne été à vous tous!
Results.Title: Je l’❤️ mourir!

Results.ReviewText: Did the engineers leave anything to improve upon?  Compared the Master-Touch to the Performance, the things that put it over for the Master-Touch was the included char-buckets, and the center removeable grill insert to add (pizza stone, cast-iron grilling insert, or the flat cast-iron skillet), and the lid catch to act as a wind-block to grill during windy days.
Results.Title: Everything Thought Out

Results.ReviewText: The MS is worth the extra few dollars for the height alone. The warming rack is on point. I will definitely be looking for another one soon!!!

Results.ReviewText: Learn all the pointers that you can on YouTube and the Weber app and or website throw learn all the tricks and trades to make the best of all your cooking on this grill
Results.Title: Learn the tricks and tips you can!

Results.ReviewText: I ordered the slate blue. Paid extra for the specialty color and 2 day shipping so that I would have it in time for the holiday weekend. The color is listed as slate blue and the photo on your website is slate blue. What arrived was gray. Very gray. Not even a little bit blue. While it will not impact its performance and its a high quality grill, I would have ordered a different color or saved myself some extra money by going with a basic black, instead of getting a lighter version of black. After spending nearly $300, it was a bit disappointing.
Results.Title: Beautiful but color is mislabeled

Results.ReviewText: Le  bbq est de haute qualite...je suirs tres satisfait
Results.Title: Tres efficace

Results.ReviewText: This is my 10th Weber Grill (I still have my other 9 as well) and my 3rd 22" Kettle.  I am setting this one up with Grillgrates and will use to grill fatty foods like Burgers and Chicken Thighs.  The Grillgrates are great at keeping flare ups at bay.  My only complaint on the grill is the Deep Ocean Blue is much lighter in person than in pictures.  I still like color but I was hoping for it to be closer to what the pictures show.  My next Weber Grill will be a 26" Performer.  That is a hint for the Weber Product Manager!  HaHa
Results.Title: Awesome Grill and Typical Weber Quality

Results.ReviewText: On the first attempt the grill exceeded 600 degrees with the chimney. Adds a nice pop of color to the deck.

14501001.Name: 22” Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill
14501001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill. This grill features a handy Tuck-Away Lid Holder that gives you a convenient place to nest the lid against the side of the bowl, a hinged cooking grate that fits circular GBS accessories so you can explore more ways to cook, a built-in lid thermometer, and legs that are 2” taller than standard kettles. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retain heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate fits circular GBS grillware· Included Char-Rails make it easy to arrange charcoal· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Tuck-Away Lid Holder provides handy space to hang lid· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels.· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant and 2” taller· 10-year limited warranty
